Name: Chubby Cats
Author: ahomiepassingby
Description:
[size=2]I love [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9925]Oversized cat[/url][size=2] but sadly, the mod is just 1 cat appearance chosen. So I made this to replace all vanilla cats with these [/size][size=4][i]chubby-fluffy cats[/i][/size][size=2] 😄[/size]

[size=2]One thing that you shouldn't do is put hats on them, because it looks so weird. But if you enjoy the fun of it, go ahead! And maybe I'll do some research to make them wear hats properly. [/size]

[b][size=4]Update:[/size][/b][size=3]They now can wear hats properly with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22631]Hats On Pets Plus[/url]!
But in case you don't wanna put anything on them, it's okay. You don't need to download the above mod and can enjoy this mod as usual!
[/size]

[size=3]And hmm... nahh, I don't have much to say, enjoy with those cuties instead :3[/size]

[size=4][b][i]Meow meow~[/i][/b][/size]

Downloads.Description: Now they can wear hats properly!
